_readme: True-cost posts: any queue row id listed under rows posts as a cost breakdown (part + install labor + what the same money would be worth invested) instead of the plain product caption. Fill part_price and install_hours from the vendor's real listing / install guide, and price_checked with the date you checked (YYYY-MM-DD) -- the row won't post until all three are filled. labor_rate per row is optional and overrides the default. diy_friendly adds an 'or $0 labor if you DIY' line; only set it true for genuine bolt-ons. The same numbers feed the build-budget tool's 'add a featured part' list.
